airn in Saudi Arabia

Round neolithic cairn or mustatil structure in Saudi Arabia near to Al Badi. It is far south from more explored mustatils. You can take a look at it via Google or Apple Maps.

The mustatil is 100 m x 200m big. It is located on a hill
